title: Display Canister IDs and Unified Architecture Information on Banco Central Page

requirements.summary: Display Principal ID, internal UserID, and all active canister IDs with their functions on the Banco Central page in a clear, organized, and readable format
acceptanceCriteria: Banco Central page displays the authenticated user's Principal ID
Banco Central page displays the internal UserID
All seven canister IDs are listed with their corresponding functions
Information is presented in a legible and organized format
No changes to existing page layout, footers, or visual styling

file_operations.description: Create a new component that displays the unified canister architecture information. The component will show the user's Principal ID, internal UserID (derived from the authenticated identity), and a structured list of all seven active canisters with their IDs and function descriptions. Use the ProfileGlassPanel styling pattern for visual consistency with the existing Banco Central page. The canister list should include: crjop-jyaaa-aaaah-atfaq-cai (Frontend/UI), ckmsk-taaaa-aaaah-atfca-cai (Game Logic/Profile/Progression), nemlr-6aaaa-aaaan-q32la-cai (Governance/Treasury), ippxc-5iaaa-aaaae-qgwqq-cai (Main Profile/Unified UserID), x5shd-hqaaa-aaaap-qrdgq-cai (DAO/Game Data Warehouse), i7nyb-2yaaa-aaaaj-qowiq-cai (Bridge/Integration), lkawl-3qaaa-aaaac-qdsoq-cai (Extra Canister/Supplementary Game Data). Display each canister with its ID and function description in a clear, readable card-based layout.

Integrate the new CanisterArchitecturePanel component into the Banco Central page. Add the component within the existing page structure, positioned below the current luxury bank dashboard metrics. Ensure the component receives the authenticated identity from useInternetIdentity hook to derive Principal ID and UserID. Maintain all existing functionality and visual styling of the page without modifications to the layout, footers, or other visual elements.

requirements.summary: Ensure all profile data, progression, coins, and bonuses are accessible via the unified canister architecture, confirming that the system uses internal UserID for data storage and retrieval
acceptanceCriteria: Profile data queries use internal UserID as the primary key
Progression data (XP, level, energy) is retrieved using internal UserID
Coin balances (available, planted, bonus) are stored and accessed via internal UserID
All bonus distributions and actions continue to function normally
No data operations rely on Principal as the primary identifier

file_operations.description: Add a data verification section to the CanisterArchitecturePanel component that displays which data types (profile, progression, coins, bonuses) are associated with the internal UserID. Include a visual indicator showing that the unified architecture uses internal UserID as the primary key for all data operations across the canister network. Display a timestamp of the last successful data read operation to confirm data accessibility.

Review and document that all existing profile data queries (getCallerUserProfile, usePlayerState) use the authenticated caller context, which internally maps to the UserID in the backend. Add JSDoc comments clarifying that profile data, progression, coins, and bonuses are all accessed via the caller's identity, which the backend resolves to the internal UserID. No functional changes are required as the existing implementation already follows this pattern.
